title: Higher Commutativity in Finite Groups, Rigidity, Extremal bounds, and Heisenberg-Type Families
summary: For a finite group $G$ and an integer $r\ge 2$ let $$ P_r(G):=\frac{|Hom(\mathbb Z^r,G)|}{|G|^r}, $$ where $\Hom(\mathbb Z^r,G)$ is the set of pairwise commuting $r$-tuples in $G$. This paper studies rigidity and extremal behavior of the hierarchy $\{P_r(G)\}_{r\ge2}$, together with a low-rank representation-theoretic / TQFT counting bridge.
